responsibility: Implements the D language parser atop the lexer. It parses modules, declarations, attributes, templates, statements, expressions, types, contracts, aggregates, imports, inline asm-related syntax hooks, and initializers; attaches comments; manages parser state such as linkage and bracket nesting; and initializes the operator-precedence table that guides expression parsing.
same_name_distinction: Defines the parser implementation bodies and initializes the shared operator-precedence table; unlike parse.h, which only declares the Parser interface and precedence types, this source file performs the actual recursive-descent parsing work.
